hypotheses.justification: By ENNReal.toReal_pos_iff, hvol implies volume U < ∞. Since volumeMeasureOn U is volume.restrict U, MeasureTheory.isFiniteMeasure_restrict supplies the deleted instance locally, after which the original proof applies. Zero and infinite volume are already excluded by hvol.

The segment estimate norm_sub_le_integral_norm_fderiv_mul_norm_sub_along_segment bounds ‖u x - u y‖ by the integrable function in hsegment. ContDiff.continuous and Continuous.aestronglyMeasurable give measurability of y ↦ u x - u y, so MeasureTheory.Integrable.mono' makes this difference integrable on U. The constant u x is integrable under the retained finite-measure instance; subtracting the difference using Integrable.sub recovers hu. The original proof then applies. This works also for d = 0; hvol already excludes zero-volume domains.
